_readme: Jacob's lines. Edit freely — this is YOUR file. Pools: 'default' plays on the regular timer; 'poke' plays when he's clicked; the 'milestone*' pools unlock when the collection's total value crosses $1k / $10k / $100k. No repeats until a pool runs out, then it reshuffles.
default: Nu? Any new treasures today?
Bubbeleh, did you eat something today? You can't collect on an empty stomach.
Mazel tov on that last find. A beauty.
This one — I'm kvelling. Look at it!
A mensch takes care of his collection. Gloves, always gloves.
Oy, the prices these days. In my day a nickel was a nickel.
You should call your mother. After you log the coin.
Such naches you give me with this collection.
Patience, tateleh. The right coin finds you.
A little schmutz on a coin? Don't you DARE clean it. You'll ruin the patina.
Never sell in a hurry. Never buy in a hurry either.
Zei gezunt! And check the mint mark twice.
That card? A metzieh. A real bargain.
Don't be a schlemiel — always check the comps first.
L'chaim! To the collection!
Your bubbe, may she rest, kept her buttons the way you keep these coins.
It shouldn't be a whole megillah — just log the coin, bubbeleh.
Come, sit. Tell me about the new card.
A collection is built one coin at a time. Like a life.
You call that a display case? Get some felt in there.
Shabbat is coming — the coins can wait until Sunday.
Such a punim on that rookie card.
Don't kvetch about the grading fees. Quality costs.
Ess, ess! Then we'll look at the registry.
For coins, I always know a guy. I ALWAYS know a guy.
This is how you build something to hand down. Dor l'dor — generation to generation.
A shanda to keep them in a shoebox. Get albums.
Half the fun is the hunt, bubbeleh. The other half is the kvelling.
Would it kill you to label the slabs?
You want my advice? Buy the coin, not the story.
Keep your receipts. Trust me on this. Keep your receipts.
A wheat penny in the couch cushions — that's how I started, you know.
Be a mensch — share the doubles with the kids.
My zayde carried a silver dollar across two oceans. Now THAT was a coin.
Chicken soup for you, archival sleeves for the cards.
Oy gevalt, another auction? Fine, fine. Show me.
The grade matters, but the story matters more.
Sunlight is for people, not for cards. Keep them in the dark.
Nu, you logged it? Good. Now we're talking.
A bissel patience — the auction ends when it ends.
poke: Gently! I'm an old man, not a slot machine.
Keep that up and no Hanukkah gelt for you this year.
That's it — no presents for Hanukkah. I mean it this time.
Ow. That's where my gallbladder used to be.
Nudge me again and I'm telling your mother.
I survived two knee replacements for this?
Poke, poke, poke. Am I a coin? Do I look graded to you?
You'll take an eye out! Mine, specifically.
milestone1k: Four figures! Kein ayin hara — don't jinx it.
A thousand dollars of history on one shelf. Mazel tov!
Now it's a collection. Before, it was a drawer.
Such naches! Now get a proper safe.
L'chaim! The first thousand is the hardest.
milestone10k: Ten thousand! Now you insure it. Today, not tomorrow.
At this level — gloves. Always gloves.
Kein ayin hara, look how it's grown!
Your zayde is kvelling, believe me.
Ten grand, and every piece with a story. That's the way.
milestone100k: A hundred thousand. I'm verklempt, bubbeleh.
This is not a hobby anymore. This is a legacy. Dor l'dor.
Such a simcha! Call the family, tell them everything.
May it go from strength to strength. L'chaim!
I am proud of you. There. I said it. Don't let it go to your head.
